expressions.cue: A note occupies exactly one line of text. Write the line count using 行, without 目. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 一行 is いちぎょう when counting a line of text. The separate いっこう group sense and こう bank counter do not fit this cue.

expressions.cue: A printed message occupies six lines. Write its text-line count using 行, without 目. For writing, use kanji or Arabic numerals.
expressions.explanation: 六行 is ろくぎょう, without contraction. Count lines, not words, characters or banks.
